mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_prompts ( prompt_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, version VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, owner VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, content CLOB NOT NULL, eval_record CLOB, content_hash VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, created_by VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (prompt_id, version) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_prompts ( prompt_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, version VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, owner VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, eval_record TEXT, content_hash VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, created_by VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (prompt_id, version) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_prompt_releases ( role VARCHAR(80) PRIMARY KEY, prompt_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, version VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, actor VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_agents ( agent_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, version VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, owner VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, oncall VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, slo_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, cost_budget DOUBLE NOT NULL, data_class VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, deploy_unit VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, manifest CLOB NOT NULL, signature VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (agent_id, version) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_agents ( agent_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, version VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, owner VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, oncall VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, slo_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, cost_budget DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, data_class VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, deploy_unit VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, manifest TEXT NOT NULL, signature VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (agent_id, version) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_agent_releases ( release_id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, agent_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, version VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, traffic_percent INT NOT NULL, action VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, actor VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_agent_releases ( release_id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, agent_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, version VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, traffic_percent INT NOT NULL, action VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, actor VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_registry_audit ( audit_id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, action VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, subject VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, outcome VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, detail VARCHAR(1000), actor VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_registry_audit ( audit_id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, action VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, subject VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, outcome VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, detail VARCHAR(1000), actor VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_approvals ( approval_id VARCHAR(200) PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, user_id VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, run_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, tool_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, operation_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, request_hash VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, parameters CLOB NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, required_permission VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, requested_at BIGINT NOT NULL, expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL, decided_by VARCHAR(200), decided_at BIGINT NOT NULL, reason VARCHAR(1000), operation_status VARCHAR(40), operation_response CLOB )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_approvals ( approval_id VARCHAR(200) PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, user_id VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, run_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, tool_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, operation_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, request_hash VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, parameters TEXT NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, required_permission VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, requested_at BIGINT NOT NULL, expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL, decided_by VARCHAR(200), decided_at BIGINT NOT NULL, reason VARCHAR(1000), operation_status VARCHAR(40), operation_response TEXT )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_alerts ( alert_id VARCHAR(200) PRIMARY KEY, kind VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, severity VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, message VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, metric_value DOUBLE NOT NULL, threshold_value DOUBLE NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_alerts ( alert_id VARCHAR(200) PRIMARY KEY, kind VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, severity VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, message VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, metric_value DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, threshold_value DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL )
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO supervisor_prompts (prompt_id, version, role, owner, status, content, eval_record, content_hash, created_by, created_at) KEY (prompt_id, version) VALUES (#{promptId}, #{version}, #{role}, #{owner}, #{status}, #{content}, #{evalRecord}, #{contentHash}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO supervisor_prompts (prompt_id, version, role, owner, status, content, eval_record, content_hash, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{promptId}, #{version}, #{role}, #{owner}, #{status}, #{content}, #{evalRecord}, #{contentHash}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (prompt_id, version) DO UPDATE SET role=EXCLUDED.role, owner=EXCLUDED.owner, status=EXCLUDED.status, content=EXCLUDED.content, eval_record=EXCLUDED.eval_record, content_hash=EXCLUDED.content_hash, created_by=EXCLUDED.created_by, created_at=EXCLUDED.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT prompt_id, version, role, owner, status, content, eval_record, content_hash, created_by, created_at FROM supervisor_prompts WHERE prompt_id = #{promptId} AND version = #{version}
SELECT prompt_id, version, role, owner, status, content, eval_record, content_hash, created_by, created_at FROM supervisor_prompts ORDER BY prompt_id, version

SELECT p.prompt_id, p.version, p.role, p.owner, p.status, p.content, p.eval_record, p.content_hash, p.created_by, p.created_at FROM supervisor_prompts p JOIN supervisor_prompt_releases r ON r.prompt_id = p.prompt_id AND r.version = p.version WHERE r.role = #{role}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO supervisor_prompt_releases (role, prompt_id, version, actor, updated_at) KEY (role) VALUES (#{role}, #{promptId}, #{version}, #{actor}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO supervisor_prompt_releases (role, prompt_id, version, actor, updated_at) VALUES (#{role}, #{promptId}, #{version}, #{actor}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (role) DO UPDATE SET prompt_id=EXCLUDED.prompt_id, version=EXCLUDED.version, actor=EXCLUDED.actor, updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT role, prompt_id, version, actor, updated_at FROM supervisor_prompt_releases ORDER BY role
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO supervisor_agents (agent_id, version, role, owner, oncall, slo_ms, cost_budget, data_class, deploy_unit, status, manifest, signature, created_at) KEY (agent_id, version) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{version}, #{role}, #{owner}, #{oncall}, #{sloMs}, #{costBudget}, #{dataClass}, #{deployUnit}, #{status}, #{manifest}, #{signature}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO supervisor_agents (agent_id, version, role, owner, oncall, slo_ms, cost_budget, data_class, deploy_unit, status, manifest, signature, created_at) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{version}, #{role}, #{owner}, #{oncall}, #{sloMs}, #{costBudget}, #{dataClass}, #{deployUnit}, #{status}, #{manifest}, #{signature}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (agent_id, version) DO UPDATE SET role=EXCLUDED.role, owner=EXCLUDED.owner, oncall=EXCLUDED.oncall, slo_ms=EXCLUDED.slo_ms, cost_budget=EXCLUDED.cost_budget, data_class=EXCLUDED.data_class, deploy_unit=EXCLUDED.deploy_unit, status=EXCLUDED.status, manifest=EXCLUDED.manifest, signature=EXCLUDED.signature, created_at=EXCLUDED.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT agent_id, version, role, owner, oncall, slo_ms, cost_budget, data_class, deploy_unit, status, manifest, signature, created_at FROM supervisor_agents WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND version = #{version}
SELECT agent_id, version, role, owner, oncall, slo_ms, cost_budget, data_class, deploy_unit, status, manifest, signature, created_at FROM supervisor_agents ORDER BY agent_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supervisor_agent_releases (agent_id, version, traffic_percent, action, status, actor, created_at) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{version}, #{trafficPercent}, #{action}, #{status}, #{actor}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE supervisor_agent_releases SET status = 'SUPERSEDED' WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT release_id, agent_id, version, traffic_percent, action, status, actor, created_at FROM supervisor_agent_releases WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY release_id DESC

SELECT r.release_id, r.agent_id, r.version, r.traffic_percent, r.action, r.status, r.actor, r.created_at FROM supervisor_agent_releases r JOIN supervisor_agents a ON a.agent_id = r.agent_id AND a.version = r.version WHERE a.role = #{role} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.traffic_percent > 0 ORDER BY r.release_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supervisor_registry_audit (action, subject, outcome, detail, actor, created_at) VALUES (#{action}, #{subject}, #{outcome}, #{detail}, #{actor}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT audit_id, action, subject, outcome, detail, actor, created_at FROM supervisor_registry_audit ORDER BY audit_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM supervisor_approvals WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND tool_name = #{toolName} AND operation_id = #{operationId} ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT 1

mapper.update: UPDATE supervisor_approvals SET status = #{status}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = #{decidedAt}, reason = #{reason} WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} AND status = 'PENDING'

INSERT INTO supervisor_alerts (alert_id, kind, severity, message, metric_value, threshold_value, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{alertId}, #{kind}, #{severity}, #{message}, #{metricValue}, #{thresholdValue}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (alert_id) DO UPDATE SET kind=EXCLUDED.kind, severity=EXCLUDED.severity, message=EXCLUDED.message, metric_value=EXCLUDED.metric_value, threshold_value=EXCLUDED.threshold_value, status=EXCLUDED.status, created_at=EXCLUDED.created_at, updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at
